steps.do: Ask the customer for a name, email or user id. Look up the record with get_user_information_by_name, get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id. Share no account details yet.

args.customer_name: as the customer states it (or use the email or user_id with the matching tool)

steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Ask for any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number and address, and compare them with the v_lookup record. If fewer than 2 match, say you cannot verify the customer, share nothing, and stop.
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and later in r_year_closed, to tell which monthly windows have closed. Each window runs from a monthly anniversary of the Platinum account opening date (read in r_accounts) to the day before the next monthly anniversary.
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

basis.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

basis.clause: window bounds: monthly anniversary of opening to the day before the next
basis.quote: Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.

steps.do: Log the verification with the v_lookup record and the v_time timestamp.
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Read the verified user's credit card accounts. Find the Platinum Rewards Card account and note its account id, opening date and status.
steps.quote: Start date: Your first monthly window begins on your account opening date.

steps.do: Decide whether the customer holds a Platinum Rewards Card account. If they do not, explain that the rebate applies only to the Platinum Rewards Card, and stop this job. If the account was closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation, or before the rebate posted for the year in question, explain that the rebate is not awarded, and stop.
steps.quote: If the account is closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or rebate posting, the rebate will not be awarded.

steps.do: Decide which cardmember year to evaluate. If the customer has not said which year they mean, ask them. Check whether the account opening date from r_accounts falls in the new-customer promo window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31), and check r_txns for an annual fee charged in the first year. If the first year's fee was waived (opened in the window, with no first-year annual fee in r_txns), the rebate does not apply to that first year. Eligibility then begins with the next cardmember year, in which the $200.00 annual fee is billed. Otherwise, evaluate the 12 consecutive monthly windows of the year the customer asks about. That year starts on the opening date, or on the anniversary of it that begins that year.
steps.quote: the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

basis.clause: which cardmember year: ask if not stated
basis.why: No passage says which cardmember year to evaluate when several exist, so the customer is asked.

basis.quote: Start date: 2024-06-01
The waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the promo window.

basis.clause: no first-year annual fee in r_txns
basis.quote: Your first statement should show no annual fee charge for the first year.

basis.clause: waived year excluded; next fee-billed year evaluated
basis.quote: If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.
after the first anniversary, the standard $200.00 annual fee applies.

basis.clause: 12 consecutive windows from the opening date or the start of the year
basis.quote: Cardmember year: Your rebate evaluation covers 12 consecutive monthly windows, starting from your account opening date (or from the start of the first fee-billed cardmember year after any promotional waiver).

steps.do: Build the 12 monthly windows of the year chosen in r_promo. Each window starts on a monthly anniversary of the account opening date from r_accounts and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary. The first window starts at the start of the chosen year, and the 12th ends the day before the next yearly anniversary. Compare the current time from v_time with the end of the 12th window. If the 12th window has not closed, the year has not been evaluated yet. Still check the closed windows: one closed window below the threshold already disqualifies the year.
steps.quote: Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.

basis.clause: window runs anniversary to the day before the next
basis.quote: Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.
Eligibility is assessed after the close of your 12th monthly window in the cardmember year.

basis.clause: one short closed window already disqualifies
basis.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

steps.do: For each window from r_year_closed (a monthly anniversary to the day before the next), total the net posted purchases by posting date. Include purchases by authorized users, virtual-card purchases and international purchases. Exclude fees, interest, adjustments, cash advances, cash-equivalent transactions, balance transfers, and person-to-person transfers or funding coded as cash equivalents. Also exclude every transaction that r_disputes shows with an unresolved dispute. Subtract returns, refunds and credits in the window in which they post.
steps.quote: Returns, refunds, or credits reduce the monthly total in the window in which the credit posts.

basis.quote: Posting date rule: Only transactions that post within a given monthly window count toward that month’s threshold. Authorization dates do not control eligibility.
Net purchases posted to your Platinum Rewards Card, including purchases made by authorized users.
Purchases made using virtual card numbers associated with your account (counted the same as your physical card).
International purchases, provided they post as purchases.
Fees, interest charges, and adjustments.

basis.clause: exclude cash advances and cash equivalents
basis.quote: Cash advances and cash-equivalent transactions (for example, money orders, traveler’s checks, and similar cash-like activity).
Balance transfers.
Person-to-person money transfers and funding transactions that are coded as cash equivalents.
Disputed transactions while unresolved.

basis.clause: returns in the window they post
basis.quote: Returns, refunds, or credits reduce the monthly total in the window in which the credit posts.

steps.do: Decide eligibility. The customer qualifies only if every one of the 12 windows has at least $7500.00 in net qualifying purchases. One closed window below $7500.00 disqualifies the whole cardmember year. There is no partial or prorated rebate.
steps.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

basis.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

basis.clause: all 12 windows; one miss disqualifies; no proration
basis.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

steps.do: Tell the customer they do not qualify and give the specific reason, without revealing internal procedures. The reason is one of these. (a) The first cardmember year's fee was waived under the promotional offer, so the rebate does not apply to that year; also report how the following year stands. (b) A monthly window had less than $7500.00 in net qualifying purchases; name that window. (c) The account was closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or the rebate posting. Explain that there is no partial rebate. If the customer asks why, repeat the specific reason.
steps.if: r_window_check, r_promo or r_has_card shows the customer does not qualify for the year evaluated
steps.quote: You must meet the monthly threshold in all 12 windows to earn the rebate for that cardmember year.

steps.if: the 12th window has not closed and every closed window met $7500.00
steps.quote: Eligibility is assessed after the close of your 12th monthly window in the cardmember year.

steps.do: Tell the customer they qualify for the $150.00 annual fee rebate. It is applied as a statement credit to the Platinum Rewards Card account after that year's annual fee is billed. Use r_txns to say whether the credit has already posted. Warn the customer that closing or product-changing the card before the rebate posts forfeits it.

steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

The customer has already been verified in this conversation, so do not verify again. If they say they will close or product-change the Platinum card while a rebate is pending, remind them that the rebate would be forfeited.

steps.do: If a read tool returns an error, or the records lack the opening date or posting dates needed to decide, tell the customer you cannot confirm eligibility right now. Ask whether they want to be transferred to a human agent, and transfer only if they agree. For the reason, pick from the highest tier of the transfer reason codes that applies: 'technical_system_error' when a system error prevented the check, otherwise the highest-tier code that fits.

rules.rule: The monthly spend threshold is $7500.00 in net qualifying purchases per monthly window. The rebate is $150.00. The annual fee is $200.00.
rules.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

basis.quote: Annual fee: $200.00.

rules.rule: All 12 monthly windows of the cardmember year must meet the threshold. One miss disqualifies the year, with no proration.
rules.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

rules.rule: An account whose application was submitted in the promo window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) and approved has its first-year annual fee waived. The rebate does not apply to a first cardmember year waived under the promotion. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the $200.00 annual fee is billed.
rules.quote: If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

basis.clause: application within the window and approved
basis.quote: Submit your application within the promo window and be approved.

basis.clause: waiver covers the first 12 months; $200.00 afterward
basis.quote: The waiver applies to the first 12 months from account opening; after the first anniversary, the standard $200.00 annual fee applies.

rules.rule: The first-year waiver applies only to applications made and approved inside the promo window.
rules.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

rules.rule: A waived first year shows no annual fee charge. Use the transactions to confirm whether the fee was billed.
rules.quote: Your first statement should show no annual fee charge for the first year.

rules.rule: Windows follow the monthly anniversary of the opening date and the posting date, not the statement cycle or the calendar month.
rules.quote: Track posted transactions by your monthly anniversary dates, not by statement cycle or calendar month.

rules.rule: Excluded from the threshold: fees, interest, adjustments, cash advances and cash equivalents, balance transfers, person-to-person transfers or funding coded as cash equivalents, and disputed transactions while unresolved. Disputes are read with get_user_dispute_history_7291.
Closing or product-changing the card before the evaluation or the rebate posting forfeits the rebate.
rules.quote: If the account is closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or rebate posting, the rebate will not be awarded.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. From the account records, the posted transactions in each anniversary window and the dispute history, the agent has told them one of three things: they qualify, they do not qualify (with the specific reason), or the year cannot be evaluated yet. Otherwise, the agent has explained a data or tool failure and offered a transfer.
